purpose: Compose retry timing/authorization with recovery-confidence hysteresis without allowing confidence state to create retry authority or shorten pacing.

planes.scheduler: http_429_survival.py controls retry authorization, timing floors, identity, and budget
planes.composition: confidence may add a conservative pacing floor while B/E; it may never override STOP/REOBSERVE or shorten a scheduler floor

invariants: First post-Blocked success enters E and does not reset failure history.
While B or E, recovery_probe_period may only increase the scheduler minimum-period floor.
A 429 is classified into B before retry timing is computed.
Confidence state never overrides REOBSERVE for ambiguous non-idempotent outcomes.
E->H is the only hysteresis transition that clears failure history.
No first-success transition may make the next recovery observation start earlier than the recovery pacing floor.
The composition layer creates no new operation replay authority.

lab_policy.note: Deterministic fixtures only; not production recommendations.
